name: Grand Maestro Sangrimm
biography: Genia amorta. A jinn impresario who trades in lifespans — every spell he casts for a 'willing' client costs them months of life, paid directly into his own. On stage he conducts swarms of vitality bats like an orchestra. Habitat: Urban.

features.name: Dealmaker
features.description: When Sangrimm casts a spell other than one he can cast at will, he must target a willing creature other than himself. As part of the casting, the target loses a number of months of its lifespan equal to the spell's level, and Sangrimm's lifespan increases by the same amount.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Sangrimm fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Metaphysical Manifestation
features.description: Sangrimm uses his Charisma in place of his Strength or Dexterity for attack rolls. On the Imaginal Plane, Sangrimm also does this for ability checks and saving throws that use Strength or Dexterity.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.description: If Sangrimm moves 20+ feet in a straight line, he gains a Fly Speed equal to his Walk Speed until the end of the turn and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures as if they were Difficult Terrain. A creature whose space Sangrimm moves through in this way for the first time on a turn is subjected to the following effect: Saving Throw: DC 18 Dexterity. Failure: 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked Prone.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Ability: Charisma; DC: 18; Modifier: +10. Sangrimm is an innate spellcaster and doesn't require Material components.

At Will: Bless (C), Bane (C)

5/Day: Death Ward, Enhance Ability, Fly (C), Freedom of Movement, Haste (C), Polymorph (C), Regenerate, True Seeing

(C) indicates Concentration. Remember Dealmaker: these spells must target a willing creature other than Sangrimm.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: Sangrimm makes one Leeching Claw attack and two Sanguine Swarm attacks.

features.name: Leeching Claw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (4d4 + 5) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Sangrimm regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

features.name: Sanguine Swarm
features.description: Sangrimm launches a bolt of blood-red life essence. Ranged Spell Attack: +10, range 90 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. Hit or Miss: A Swarm of Vitality Bats appears under Sangrimm's control in a space within 5 feet of the target. The swarm takes its turn immediately after Sangrimm and dissipates at the start of Sangrimm's next turn.

features.name: Vanishing Act
features.description: Sangrimm teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet of himself. Saving Throw: DC 18 Constitution, each creature within 5 feet of Sangrimm when he disappears or reappears. Failure: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

features.name: Bloodflame (Legendary Action)
features.description:
Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, Sangrimm can expend a use to take one of the following actions. Sangrimm regains all expended uses at the start of each of his turns.

Sangrimm creates a spike of crimson necrotic flame from the ground that shoots up at a creature. Saving Throw: DC 18 Dexterity, one creature Sangrimm can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Ringleader (Legendary Action)
features.description: Sangrimm commands one Swarm of Vitality Bats he controls within 60 feet. The swarm can move up to its Speed and make one attack.

features.name: Showmanship (Legendary Action)
features.description: Sangrimm makes a contested Charisma (Performance) check against the Wisdom (Insight) check of a creature that isn't fighting him within 120 feet of him that can see or hear him. If his check total is higher, the creature jeers distractingly at Sangrimm's foes. The next attack roll made against Sangrimm before the start of his next turn has Disadvantage.
